Mod.Name: More Girls
Mod.Author: 清明葬花祭|lapismind
Mod.Description: Original extension for All Girls: a milk seller, a fortune teller, a green-cloak girl heading for the tower, and nine new visitors in 0.1.3 (vampire, elf, dark elf, mummy, angel, zombie, wandering swordswoman, cheerleader, ninja), and in 0.2.0 six more (magical girl, idol, oni girl, slime, Miss Christmas, succubus), a Keepsake Album for the keepsakes your visitors leave, and the Spirit Anomaly item to help you meet them; 0.2.1 adds the goddess. Explore them yourself. Requires All Girls (all_girls) to be enabled too (portraits).
